gaps.GAP-01: Video-only has no input-state vocabulary or binding reference: MISSING/UNKNOWN/PROXY/HOLD and adopted refs cannot be carried; a proxy file or a colour stand-in is accepted.
gaps.GAP-02: Video-only plan does not pin source content: plan_sha256 is unchanged when same-size source bytes change (hash first appears in the render receipt).
gaps.GAP-03: AV mux has no slot for a video render receipt or any video qualification: the video is bound by path+sha256 only and is not inspected by plan.
gaps.GAP-04: The audio receipt is optional in AV mux and only status, stem sha256 and sample_count are read: a hand-written or edited receipt is accepted; no ownership/authentication/binding to the plan or manifest.
gaps.GAP-05: AV mux drops audio-receipt warnings (ZERO_FILL_APPLIED, NO_AUDIO_EVENTS_SELECTED) and cannot tell an all-zero stem from intentional silence.
gaps.GAP-06: No field anywhere for phrase-boundary or sample-timing qualification: equal-length USE ranges are accepted however the boundaries were chosen.
gaps.GAP-07: selection.ref, decision_ref and scope are not cross-checked between stages: AV mux has no scope, no plan/manifest hash link and no --episode.
gaps.GAP-08: Exit code 0 for non-ready outcomes: audiomix `mix` dry-run on a HOLD plan, audiomix `validate` with hold_if_planned, avmux `plan` with UNVERIFIED readiness.
gaps.GAP-09: policy.gap=ALLOW_ZERO_FILL turns absent audio into zeros with a warning only (READY, exit 0).
gaps.GAP-10: Outcome vocabulary differs per stage: audiomix returns HOLD (exit 5); video-only and AV mux reject unresolved input (exit 1, issue code only), so HOLD survives AV mux only as the code input_state_not_use.
gaps.GAP-11: BY DESIGN: no carrier for execution permission or creative approval (unknown fields are rejected); these are owner records the library neither stores nor infers.
gaps.GAP-12: OWNER TASK: promoting the stem into AV mux's single asset root (neither stage may write inside its own asset root) is nobody's job in the library; only the sha256 pin protects the copy.
gaps.GAP-13: NOT EXERCISED: source immutability is detected (re-hash after mix/mux), not prevented; this job ran no mix/mux, so post-run re-hash behaviour is documented, not re-demonstrated.
gaps.GAP-14: An audio receipt that is valid JSON of an unexpected shape (array, string, null, outputs/readback of the wrong type) makes `avmux plan` die with an uncaught AttributeError: exit 1 like a structured rejection, but empty stdout, a traceback and no issue code. Fail-closed (nothing created), yet only distinguishable from a rejection by the empty stdout.

layers.CALLER_GUARD_DEMO: An illustrative owner-side guard (reference_guards.py), shown next to the library's behaviour. Never the reason a test passes; not part of the library; not a replacement validator.
layers.INSTRUMENT: Harness self-checks: positive control of the audit hook/sentinel, refusal of execution flags.
layers.LIBRARY_ENFORCED: Asserted on the library's own output: it refused, held, reported or computed this. This is what the library checks.
layers.LIBRARY_PERMISSIVE: Asserted on the library's own output: it ACCEPTED or omitted this. The owner must guard it. The assertion pins the gap - if the library ever closes it, the test fails loudly so the contract is updated.
layers.ROLLBACK: Steps of the isolated-copy rollback demonstration.

library_under_test.note: every source reference is resolved against the file at run time; a symbol or literal that no longer exists fails the run

not_claimed: No adoption of this library by any existing application, exporter or workflow; this is a generic public abstraction of requirements.
No operational readiness, no production state read or changed, no production source or asset used.
No creative, visual, audio, speech, timing or story-quality claim; real story/voice/timing is unresolved and is not inferable from synthetic fixtures.
No ffmpeg/ffprobe, render, mix, mux or download was executed; the 'videos' are plain non-media bytes; the audio receipt used for AV-mux plans is harness-fabricated.
Linux x86_64 only; Python 3.11/3.12/3.13 only; macOS and Windows untested (the harness is POSIX-only).
End-to-end `mux --mux` preflight behaviour was not run; only its pure comparison function was exercised on canned dicts.

observations.OB-01: Unselected audio rows are still schema-validated (a malformed unselected row rejects the whole manifest), but never read, hashed or overlap-checked.
observations.OB-02: audiomix and avmux plans hash and parse the files they read; the video-only plan only stats them.

scope: Cross-stage integration contract for the existing public video-only / audiomix / avmux library: what each stage verifies, what existing owners must supply, how missing qualification, failure and rollback propagate.
